Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You turn your bow across your body and loose as the charging enemy comes within arm’s reach.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One visible enemy immediately after it ends voluntary movement adjacent to you.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires a ranged weapon and ammunition; grants one ordinary ranged weapon and one d8 ammunition bundle if absent, each Bulk 1.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Make one free Basic Ranged attack against that enemy, using that card’s attribute, damage, range and ammunition check. Forced movement cannot trigger this card. A free attack or movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger it, and this attack cannot trigger further free attacks.
